photo.title: Profile of a man wearing traditional native american costume. He has chin length hair with a fringe and wears a feather on the right side of his hair. He also has many beaded necklaces and wears a dark coloured shirt and vest (poncho?). See also 1998.251.28.1, 3.

Portrait of a man standing in front of a cracking mud or cement wall, with a boarded window and a bag hanging from a hook on the exterior of the building. Man wears light coloured boots, with fur around the tops, dark trousers (the knees dirty), and is wrapped in a large dark coloured blanket. He also wears a light coloured fabric headband.

Woman sits on a woven rug outside a building with painted plaster walls (light monochrome) with open door on the left. She wears light coloured boots, dark coloured dress, white slip under the dress, and a woven blanket around her shoulders. She has cheek length hair parted in the middle.

Profile of a woman sitting against a light coloured painted wall. She wears a dark coloured dress with dark woven blanket over her shoulders. Her hair is parted in the middle and is cheek length, except for a longer bit on the side which is twisted.

Portrait of a woman in white dress with beaded necklace and large white bow in her hair, which is tied back. She holds a mirror in her hands, but does not look into the mirror. She sits in front of a building with a wooden door.

Portrait of a man standing in front of a light coloured wall. He wears a light shirt, almost entirely covered by a dark coloured vest with buttons, and a jacket of the same colour and material. Chain attached to one of the vest buttons in the middle. He also wears a dark coloured scarf around his neck. Hair parted in the middle. See also 1998.251.28.18

Profile of a man standing in front of a light coloured wall and door with white sheet over it. He wears a dark coloured jacket and a dark coloured scarf around his neck. He also wears earrings and many beaded necklaces. A second scarf hangs on of a pocket in his jacket. Hair parted in the middle and also the back section is tied back into a bun with a piece of fabric.

Portrait of man standing in front of a doorway of a building with a white sheet over the wood. Man wears dark trousers, velvet shirt with buttons, a belt made of metal disks, a beaded necklace and hat. Shadow on left side of photograph and shadow of photographer visible bottom right.

Portrait of a young woman standing outside a building with a wooden door covered by a white sheet. She wears a medium coloured under-dress or shirt, with dark coloured tunic over top with woven belt. Her hair is coiled in two ponytails on either side of her head and she has a large fringe, parted in the middle.

Man stands in traditional dress against cracked mud or cement wall of a building. He wears dark coloured shoes, trousers and long sleeved shirt, with long vest over top (poncho?) woven in dark colours, with belt made of metal disks and many beaded light coloured necklaces. His hair is chin length and he has a fringe. There is a feather in his hair. Children sit against low stone wall on either side of him. See also 1998.251.2,3.

Profile of a man standing in front of a light coloured wall. He wears a dark coloured jacket and a dark coloured scarf around his neck. He also wears earrings. Hair parted in the middle. See also 1998.251.28.17

Portrait of an older woman holding a child which stands on her knees. Woman wears very dark coloured shirt and has her hair parted in the middle. Child wears light coloured dress. They are in front of a light coloured wall. Head of a third person at the bottom left.

Portrait of a man using a hammer to hit an object - he is making shell beads. He is seated outside and wears dark coloured cord trousers, dark coloured long sleeved shirt and dark coloured headband over his cheek length hair, parted in the middle. He also wears light coloured beaded necklace.

Portrait of a man (torso and head) standing against a cracking cement or mud wall of a building. He has chin length hair with a fringe, and wears many beaded white necklaces over a dark coloured vest (poncho?). See also 1998.251.28.1,2.

Profile of a man wearing a dark coloured shirt, with a studded belt across one shoulder. He also wears a scarf and fabric hat. He has long hair tied up in a bun. He stands in front of a stone wall and wooden door of a building. See 1998.251.28.5.

Portrait of a man standing in front of a stone building with wooden door. He wears dark coloured shoes, trousers and shirt, with studded belt around his waist and one across his right shoulder. The front of his shirt has 12 large light coloured buttons. He also wears a scarf around his neck and a fabric hat. See also 1998.251.28.4

Portrait of a woman in dark coloured dress with woven dark coloured vest with ties overtop. She wears several light coloured beaded necklaces, one with large amulet at bottom, and earrings. Her hair is tied in two wide buns above her ears on either side of her head. She stands against painted plaster wall of building, exterior.

Portrait of a woman (upper part of torso and head) wearing dark coloured poncho or vest with small tassels, in dark colour. Her hair is in two braids, parted in the middle. She is in front of a light coloured wall outside.
Three woven baskets and two wooden carvings (?) with painting. Tags on different areas of the baskets indicating different features. Three larger labels on wall describing baskets and wooden plaques.
Profile portrait of man, 'last survivor of Bear Class of Walpi: living with Tewa of Hano.'  He is wearing shell and turquoise necklace with eagle down feather in his hair.
Profile portrait of Tewa man, 'oje p'e,y (Black Ear) of Stick Clan of Hano, married to a Moqui woman of Mishongnavi.'   He is wearing ear ornament and European jacket.
